limits: VM-only real USB; no host experimental install, shared hub reset or manual power operation.
Never-selected Queued/opcode0/step0 to Cancelled/-ECANCELED for both typed domains, both target roles and three fd cases. Wrong token rejection and dup first-close ownership retained.
Peer current Ready/Managed/scan On observed before, inside FIFO section and after target cancellation/Free; exact START before quiet window and STOP/START/STOP afterward, then actual peer Free.

Zero DLI command/reply/failure in each six complete quiet windows. Across gaps only the 36 recorded successful peer commands/replies are allowed; the complete bootstrap-to-final-peer-release interval has exactly46 commands/replies, no unmatched traffic.
One vCPU with privileged bounded FIFO controls request selection. Ordinary concurrent scheduling and result eviction remain separate gates.
Only first selected physical initialization step partial accepted in prior evidence; real later selected steps remain required.
Artificial guest IN error and RF20+2 are development support, not natural autonomous fault recovery or physical unplug acceptance.
Manual cold power is diagnostic only. Software off/on bulk failure and natural timeout/re-enumeration/disappearance RCA remain open. All original whole issues and draft PRs stay open.
